description: Needs an API key. Edits a converted image, free (no credits). By colour, with only the palette from inspect_vector: mergeColours {a, b} (labels; a takes b's colour), splitColour {label}, snapPalette {rules: [{color: [r,g,b], to?: [r,g,b], drop?: true, tolerance}]} (change or drop colours; tolerance 0–2 is required, and 0.05–0.15 snaps near shades only), setColourCount {n} (fewer colours, at most the traced count). By region, with region.region from inspect_vector at a pixel of its preview image: recolor {region, color: [r,g,b]}, setTransparent {region} (cuts it out), mergeIntoNeighbour {region, neighbour}, move {region, dx, dy} (source pixels), delete {region} (shows what is beneath). Send rev, the revision you last saw (0 for a token never edited). If the token changed since, the result is a conflict error with the current rev and edits: check them, then resend. undo: n removes the last n edits. Returns the new preview image and palette, and fresh signed links to the formats already made (valid for 1 hour; earlier links stop working).

inline_max_bytes.description: Largest edited SVG, in bytes, to include in the result (default 16384). The preview image comes up to 1048576 bytes. 0 leaves both out.

neighbour.description: A region key {x, y, label}: region.region from inspect_vector.

region.description: A region key {x, y, label}: region.region from inspect_vector.

rev.description: The revision from your last inspect_vector or edit_vector (0 for a new token).

undo.description: Remove the last n edits instead of applying ops.

name: edit_vector

error.description: Set only on a conflict: the token changed since rev; resend with the rev here.

files.description: Fresh signed links to the edited files already made. Links from before the edit no longer work.

palette.description: The colours of the edited result, largest share first. labels are the keys mergeColours and splitColour take.

preview.description: The preview image: its size in pixels, and preview pixels per source pixel.

rev.description: The new revision: send it with the next edit.

stale.description: Edits in the log that no longer apply (index into edits, and why). They stay in the log.

svg.description: The edited SVG, when it is at most inline_max_bytes.

title: Edit a vector
